summary: Seasoned HR professional with over 20 years of experience in corporate, non‑profit, and retail environments, specializing in talent acquisition, benefits administration, policy development, and organizational development.

experience.title: HR Manager
responsibilities: Lead HR functions for corporate, fulfillment, and data center operations, including benefits, payroll, and employee relations.
Develop and implement HR programs, policies, and procedures aligned with regulatory compliance.
Drive talent acquisition, retention, and compensation strategy, reducing projected health benefit increases from 46% to 5% in the first month.
Manage HRIS systems, providing reporting and analytics to support workforce decisions.
Design and deliver training and organizational development initiatives.

experience.title: Sr. HR Manager
responsibilities: Partnered with local and corporate HR to design policies, processes, and technology for a startup environment.
Recruited over 220 full‑time hourly associates and 27 managers, converting agency staff to permanent roles.
Established HR business office, including personnel files, new‑hire practices, payroll, and reporting.
Provided strategic HR guidance to site leadership, supporting peak‑season staffing and operations.
Implemented HR technology innovations and maintained policy consistency across multiple locations.

experience.title: HR Director
responsibilities: Directed HR for two business units in a non‑profit health care organization with 184 employees.
Led merger of five physician practices, creating unified compensation, benefits, and employment contracts.
Implemented performance review program and employee satisfaction surveys, achieving 85% satisfaction.
Negotiated 100+ salary offers and recruited senior leadership (CEO, COO, CFO, CMO).
Authored employee manual covering disciplinary procedures, FMLA, attendance, and benefits.

experience.title: HR Representative
responsibilities: Performed generalist HR duties for a large discount retailer, including recruiting, benefits administration, and disciplinary action.
Coached management on interviewing and hiring best practices.
Supported the launch of a 1.2‑million‑sq‑ft distribution center, hiring 400+ employees in the first year.
Managed 878 hourly employees across three shifts and led morale‑boosting programs.
Addressed employee relations issues, including harassment and discrimination.
